# Unblock the Chain

> Web3 security audits, smart contract assurance, and RWA tokenization reviews for protocols and institutions.

Unblock the Chain delivers enterprise-grade blockchain security: manual and tool-assisted smart contract reviews, architecture and threat modeling for real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, and broader Web3 security engagements.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://unblockthechain.com/): Services overview, process, FAQ, and contact.
- [Research](https://unblockthechain.com/research): Weekly institutional-grade crypto market research (Markdown reports).

## Contact & intake

- Email: contact@unblockthechain.com
- Audit request: use the “Request audit” / intake form linked from the homepage (see Home).
